title: Tackling Recent Rise in Dengue Cases
what_it_is: Tackling Recent Rise in Dengue Cases

sections.label: Rising dengue cases expected
sections.summary: Recent months saw more cases than in corresponding periods of previous years, and 2016 cases are expected to be high and spike earlier than usual.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: However, we should worry because in the recent few months, there have been a higher number of cases compared to corresponding periods in previous years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We expect the total number of dengue cases in 2016 to be high, with cases spiking earlier than usual.

sections.label: NEA inspections and breeding habitats
sections.summary: From November to December 2015, NEA conducted over 193,000 inspections and removed over 4,000 breeding habitats, mostly in homes, in containers and flowerpots.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: From November to December 2015, NEA conducted more than 193,000 inspections and removed more than 4,000 breeding habitats, the majority of which were found in homes, and this can be found in containers, flowerpots, the usual places.

sections.label: Households fined in dengue clusters
sections.summary: More than 1,000 households in dengue clusters were fined in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Already more than 1,000 households in dengue clusters were fined in 2015.

sections.label: Wolbachia mosquito suppression funding
sections.summary: More than $3 million is committed over three years to develop a method of suppressing Aedes mosquitoes using male Aedes mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia, a bacterium that can prevent eggs hatching.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In addition, more than $3 million has been committed over the next three years to develop a novel method of suppressing the Aedes mosquito population through the use of male Aedes mosquitoes that carry Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that can prevent mosquito eggs from hatching.

sections.label: Residential breeding and enforcement numbers
sections.summary: The number of residential premises found breeding is large, but enforcements against residential premises are about equal to those against construction sites.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The number of residential premises that we have discovered breeding is actually large.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But on record the number of enforcements that we have carried out against residential premises is about equal to that of construction sites.

sections.label: Wolbachia Aedes aegypti not GM
sections.summary: The department has been looking at suppressing the Aedes aegypti population, prevalent in warm weather, and the Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti is not a genetically modified organism.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our department has been looking at what we can do to suppress the population, first, of Aedes aegypti, particularly prevalent during warm weather.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti is not a genetically modified (GM) organism.

sections.label: 2015 Singapore inspections count
sections.summary: In 2015 alone, there were 1.4 million inspections around Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Altogether, in 2015 alone, there were 1.4 million inspections around Singapore.

sections.label: Powers to enter premises
sections.summary: If there is no response within a week, powers allow access into premises to inspect and destroy breeding found.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Maybe they are on holiday or for whatever reason.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But within a week, if there is no response, particularly in this period, we will have enough powers to get access into the premises and do the necessary inspection and destruction of breeding, if it is found.
